title: Sr Engineer I- Game Testing
description:
At Aristocrat, we aim to bring happiness to life through the power of play. As a Sr Engineer I- Game Testing, you will play a key role in this mission. Our culture is based on innovation, collaboration, and a passion for creating world-class gaming experiences. Joining our team means contributing to a leading company in gaming content and technology. Your work will affect millions of users around the globe.
  
  
This role is central to our Quality Assurance team. It ensures our digital games are of the highest quality before release. If you are passionate about game testing, have proven experience, and want to work on ambitious projects, this opportunity is for you!
  
  
What You'll Do

* Test various games developed for online and mobile markets, ensuring flawless performance.
* Collaborate with QA Manager and QA team lead to prepare and complete comprehensive test cases and strategies.
* Build and complete test cases, conducting detailed product requirements analysis.
* Identify, document, and report bugs effectively, adhering to business requirements.
* Interact with cross-functional teams to resolve issues and streamline processes.
* Suggest improvements to tools, processes, and test cases to improve overall testing efficiency.
* Take ownership of your work, contributing to the full lifecycle of a project.
* Perform quality evaluations and offer premium games through digital platforms.
* Play a key role in maintaining the high standards of Aristocrat’s gaming products.

What We're Looking For

* 2+ years of testing experience, with a preference for candidates experienced in game testing.
* A passion for testing and launching highly scalable games across digital platforms.
* Hands-on experience in software testing.
* Excellent communication skills, attention to detail, and effective time management.
* Ability to effectively manage and complete tasks in a dynamic environment.
* Automation experience is a plus.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to improving testing processes.

Join us at Aristocrat and be part of a team that values individual ownership and strives for excellence in every project. Help us deliver flawless and engaging gaming experiences to our users worldwide!
  
  
*This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.*
**Compensation Philosophy**
We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.
  
  
Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.
  
  
Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

title: Lead QA – Retail & Commercial Banking
description:
We are looking for a Lead QA with 10+ years of experience in software testing, strong expertise in Retail and Commercial Banking, and hands-on experience in API and Database Testing. Experience with FIS Core Banking is required.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end QA activities including test planning, test case design, execution, defect management, and release validation.
* Translate business and technical requirements into comprehensive test scenarios and test cases.
* Perform and oversee functional, integration, regression, system, and end-to-end testing.
* Lead API testing covering service validation, request/response, error handling, and integration flows.
* Perform database testing using SQL, including data validation, data integrity, and reconciliation.
* Validate banking workflows and integrations leveraging knowledge of FIS Core Banking.
* Exposure to test automation and CI/CD.
* Experience working with distributed/onshore-offshore teams.
* Manage defect triage, prioritization, root-cause analysis, and resolution with development teams.
* Provide QA status, risks, and quality metrics to project and business stakeholders.
* Mentor QA team members and drive adherence to QA standards and best practices.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 10+ years of QA/testing experience, including experience in a Lead QA role.
* Strong domain knowledge of Retail and Commercial Banking.
* Hands-on experience with API Testing and Database Testing/SQL.
* Experience with FIS Core Banking.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile/Scrum, and defect lifecycle.
* Experience with tools such as Postman, Jira/Azure DevOps, or equivalent.
* Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and team leadership skills.

title: TEST MODULE LEAD - Functional Testing
description:
QA Engineer

Jaipur

5-8 Years

* Familiarity with Agile management experience methodologies.

* Experience with cross-browser testing tools.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

If you are passionate about quality assurance and have the required skills, we encourage you to apply and join our team in delivering high-quality software solutions.

title: Senior Professional, Digital Solutions
description:
**Job Description**
WSP is seeking an AI Engineer to develop and support production-oriented Generative AI solutions for the Middle East AI portfolio from the Bengaluru GCC. The role will work across AI products, agents, automation workflows and enterprise integrations, with emphasis on secure engineering, measurable quality and responsible AI.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop GenAI applications, agents and automation workflows using approved designs and engineering standards.
* Implement retrieval-augmented generation, function calling, structured outputs and prompt patterns to improve solution reliability and usability.
* Integrate AI components with enterprise systems, APIs, approved vector search services and governed data sources.
* Build and maintain ingestion, chunking, embedding, indexing and retrieval pipelines for structured and unstructured content.
* Create evaluation datasets and execute repeatable testing for accuracy, grounding, safety, latency and solution quality.
* Apply responsible AI controls including validation, guardrails, content filtering, traceability and human oversight.
* Develop clean, reusable and well-documented Python components and participate in code reviews.
* Support deployment, monitoring, incident resolution and continuous optimisation of AI solutions.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related discipline.
* 0–3 years of relevant software, data or AI engineering experience, including internships or strong project experience.
* Working knowledge of Python, REST APIs, SQL and software engineering fundamentals.
* Practical understanding of LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering and evaluation methods.
* Exposure to Azure AI services, Git-based development, CI/CD and cloud security principles.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation and stakeholder communication skills.

**WSP-Aligned Technology Stack**
The role will use and support the approved enterprise stack below. Equivalent technologies may be considered only where formally approved through WSP architecture, security and governance processes.
  
  
**Cloud platform**
Microsoft Azure
  
  
**AI services**
Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure AI Document Intelligence, Azure Machine Learning and approved Azure AI services
  
  
**Application hosting**
Azure App Service, Azure Functions and Azure Kubernetes Service where architecturally approved
  
  
**Data and security**
Azure Storage, Azure Key Vault, SQL and approved NoSQL services
  
  
**Engineering lifecycle**
Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD, automated testing, Azure Monitor and approved observability services
  
  
**Architecture**
REST APIs, microservices, event-driven and serverless patterns, secure API-first integration
  
  
**Expected Outcomes**

* Deliver maintainable AI components that progress from prototype through controlled production deployment.
* Improve solution quality through structured evaluation, monitoring and iterative optimisation.
* Contribute to reusable AI capabilities and patterns across the Middle East portfolio.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Microsoft Azure or Azure AI certification.
* Experience with agentic AI orchestration, document intelligence or enterprise search.
* Knowledge of MLOps, model lifecycle management and production monitoring.
* Experience working in multi-disciplinary, agile or globally distributed teams.

**Ways of Working**

* Collaborate effectively with Middle East stakeholders, GCC delivery teams, product owners, engineering specialists and enterprise technology functions.
* Work within WSP standards for architecture, cybersecurity, data protection, responsible AI, quality assurance and delivery governance.
* Communicate clearly, document decisions and support transparent delivery reporting across distributed teams.

**BGV:**

* Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.
* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Earth & Environment, Power & Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
  
  
With approximately
**4,000 talented people**
across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru & Mumbai offices) in India and more than
**73,000 globally**
, in 550
**offices across 40 countries**

Uniﬁed under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones:
**Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise.**
**www.wsp.com**

title: Senior Control & Protection Application Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d’optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l’identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d’études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production.
  
  
Agit sur la capacité de l'équipe à atteindre les objectifs en matière de service, de qualité et de respect des délais. Ce rôle est soumis aux objectifs de la politique opérationnelle. Il dispose d'une autonomie modérée. Des niveaux élevés de discernement opérationnel sont nécessaires pour obtenir les résultats escomptés.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Rôles et responsabilités**

* Effectue l'intégration des composants et des produits. Toutes les activités qui englobent plusieurs composants et produits et concernées par l'intégration des solutions pour une performance et une opérabilité maximales. Gère les exigences, les spécifications et les flux de produits et de systèmes. Dirige les activités de validation et de vérification pour l'ensemble du produit/système, comprenant les tests au niveau du système. Responsable de la définition des exigences produits pour les équipes module/composant/sous-traitants et partenaires. Gère l'interface entre les composants et les organisations d'exécution. Responsable de la gestion des transactions de CTQ/Risque au sein des équipes chargées de la conception des composants. Gère la configuration globale du produit et le système de contrôle de la configuration.
* Nécessite des connaissances spécialisées de la fonction. Influe sur l'élaboration d'une stratégie dans son domaine de responsabilité, y compris sur le contrôle des ressources et sur la formulation des politiques.
* Interprète les enjeux commerciaux internes et externes simples et recommande des meilleures pratiques pour améliorer les produits, processus ou services. Reste informé des tendances de l'industrie susceptibles d'éclairer son travail.
* Fait preuve d'un haut niveau de discernement pour prendre des décisions, et gérer des tâches ou des problèmes complexes dans les domaines de l'exploitation, de la gestion des produits, de la fabrication, de la technologie ou de l'ingénierie. Possède la capacité d'évaluer la qualité des informations fournies et sait poser des questions pertinentes aux parties prenantes. Est capable de résoudre des problèmes avec des solutions innovantes qui sortent du cadre des paramètres établis, mais aussi d'élaborer des recommandations. Fait appel à des ressources internes et externes en dehors de sa propre fonction pour l'aider à prendre une décision.
* Dirige, s'il y a lieu, des équipes fonctionnelles ou des projets dont les besoins en ressources, les risques et/ou la complexité sont réduits. Exprime des concepts difficiles et peut influencer les opinions de ses collègues sur des sujets particuliers. Peut amener autrui à envisager une question selon un point de vue différent.

**Qualifications De Base**


* Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis - Ce rôle nécessite une expérience avancée de la fonction et de la station de travail audio numérique. Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une maîtrise dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent).
* Pour les rôles aux États-Unis - Maîtrise d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 6 ans d'expérience dans la fonction).

**Caractéristiques souhaitées**

* Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité démontrée d'analyse et de résolution des problèmes. Capacité démontrée à diriger des programmes/projets. Capacité à documenter, planifier, lancer et exécuter des programmes. Compétences établies en gestion de projet.Remarque : Pour se conformer aux exigences légales américaines en matière d'immigration et autres, il est nécessaire de préciser le nombre minimum d'années d'expérience requis pour tout poste basé aux États-Unis. Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis, pour assurer la conformité avec la législation applicable, les juristes doivent mentionner le niveau d'expérience requis et non PAS un nombre minimum d'années.Cette description de poste a pour but de fournir un guide détaillé du rôle. Toutefois, il n'est pas prévu de modifier ou de restreindre et/ou d'élargir de quelque manière que ce soit les tâches requises de chaque employé, telles qu'elles sont définies dans leur contrat de travail respectif et/ou convenues d'un commun accord entre un employé et son responsable.

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
No

title: Research & Development – Validation – Design Engineer – Validation – III (BB1525FT RM 4538)
description:
**Position: Research & Development – Validation – Design Engineer – Validation – III (BB1525FT RM 4538)**
**Education: B.E. or M.E. in Electronics and Communications**
Senior Engineering Program Manager responsible for comprehensive validation of SOC Products as per Project key product indicators (KPI’s) defined. Manage and support validation of multiple SOCs in parallel. Managing activities including Audits, Resource Management, Hiring, Budgets for the team for effective validation. Interacting with Global teams and representation for validation.
  
  
**Planning**
Drives and updates Vxx quarterly validation project HC numbers working with the Validation Leads, functional managers, and other PMs. Coordinates verification and approval of the validation resource planning numbers with Val Leads, Chip Leads, and SoC PMs. Manages, updates, and ensures correctness of Sciforma validation data and scenario planner with Vxx numbers. Collects, coordinates, and maintains validation CapEx and OpEx requirements working with the Validation Leads, functional managers, and other PMs. Manages, tracks, and reports validation budget updates across projects, teams, and sites. Manages, tracks, and follows up with stakeholders on dependencies for projects; Notifies any issues to the Val Lead.
  
  
**Pre-silicon Emulation**
Collects, manages, and drives emulation capacity requirements for each project working with Validation Leads and Emulation Design and Methodologies Team (CTO). Collects, coordinates, and maintains emulation requirements from various emulation stakeholders . Coordinates, schedules, and track test plans readiness with the validation teams as per emulation requirements & emulation milestones. Tracks and follows up with content owners on content readiness for various emulation milestones. Develops, updates, and publishes emulation coverage indicators for each project working with the Val Lead and content owners. Develops, updates, and publishes emulation model release indicators (number of models per milestones, delays, etc.)
  
  
**Pre-silicon Readiness**
Tracks and follows up with content teams on content readiness for silicon. Collects and tracks boards requirements for projects. Collects and tracks parts requirements for projects. Schedules, tracks, and follows up on test plan reviews with the validation teams and relevant stakeholders before bring-up
  
  
**Execution**
Manages priority and allocation of boards for silicon bring-up and execution working with the Val Lead. Tracks and publishes actual vs. plan boards deliveries to the teams. Manages allocation of lab benches working with the Val Lead for silicon bring-up and execution. Manages priority and allocation of parts working with the Val Lead for silicon bring-up and execution. Tracks and publishes actual vs. plan parts deliveries to the teams. Tracks, and follows up with content owners, validation execution tasks for various milestones for both pre- and post-silicon. Maintains and publishes validation execution indictors (actual vs. plan). Publishes weekly execution status using a standard report template. Manages, tracks, and publishes status of project risks.

title: Manager - IT Business Analysis
description:
Internal Job Posting
  
  
Last date to apply : 28th Oct
  
  
We are seeking a talented individual to join Marsh People & Investment at Marsh Tech. This role will be based in Noida/Gurgaon. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
Manager - IT Business Analysis - AI
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Systems Analyst is a role in our scaled agile framework POD and Squad model. As part of a POD team the Senior System Analyst will support one or more cross-functional squads comprised of a Squad Lead, Developers, a System Analyst, and Quality Assurance Engineers committed to ensuring the successful design and delivery of complex application solutions centered on the strategic roadmap for one or more key technology capabilities within MMC. The Senior System Analyst will be primarily responsible for directing the cross-functional elicitation and elaboration of requirements across squads in an Agile Team setting.
  
  
As part of your daily activities, you will collaborate with the Product Owner and teams to manage tactical aspects of iteration planning such as the squads’ backlog, backlog grooming, user story refinement, user story estimation, facilitating Sprint Reviews, and participating in Agile Ceremonies. As a trusted part of a team, you will coordinate activities with up to four System Analysts across squads to ensure just-in-time development of the story.
  
  
You will also assist the Product Owner in the development of personas, customer journey maps, story maps and release planning to foster insights and understanding of vision for the team.
  
  
**We will count on you to:**

* Be a highly motivated team player working within MMC Agile culture, within a specified agile framework of Scrum or KANBAN and maintain a willingness for continuously improving your agile mindset.
* Direct analysis on critical initiatives requiring significant strategic change across multiple platforms and products.
* Ensure that teams are consistently converting the business requirements to solutions, consisting of epics and features, considering technical constraints and existing technical architecture/functionality.
* Work with the Product Owner to communicate the product vision, roadmap, value, and MVP to the agile teams to enable empathy and a shared understanding thereby helping the team to formulate an appropriate solution.
* Collaborate with the Pod Leadership, Product Owner, and stakeholders to create Persona’s, Story Maps, and a Release Plan for the project.
* Work in partnership with the Product Owner and agile teams in the creation and maintenance of Product Backlog Items ensuring that Epics and User Stories are continuously prioritized and aligned to the Product Roadmap and MVP.
* Facilitate refinement sessions with the Agile Teams and Business to sufficiently detail out User Stories, to include dependencies.
* Facilitate the Sprint Review ceremony by working with the agile teams, Product Owner, Business and Customer to review, assess and adapt the latest product increment by incorporating customer insights and feedback into the Product Backlog.
* Actively work with Pod Leadership by running assessments processes for the POD and provide constructive feedback towards continuously improving the Systems Analyst function, standards and processes in Global Technology.
* Lead workshops and work collaboratively with data engineers, data architects, technical experts, and AI engineers to integrate AI solutions into a POD.
* Demonstrate an awareness of MMC and Mercer Technical, Security and Process Standards and work with the team to incorporate them in product delivery through the software development life cycle.

**What you need to have:**

* Highly motivated candidate who is an inquisitive rapid learner that is comfortable working as part of a remote team.
* Possess strong communication skills with the capability of working collaboratively within the organization, regardless of boundaries.
* An effective communicator for both technical and business-oriented audience.
* Demonstrated requirements gathering skills showcasing the capture of customer needs and business drivers using a variety of techniques into product backlog items such as Epics and User Stories.
* Proven quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Skilled in providing process improvement and integration opportunities with other process automation tools.
* Self-motivated and ability to learn through research and self-training.
* Ability to remove impediments for squads by providing timely responses and solutions as required.
* Ability to find resolutions regarding own work methods requiring minimal direction.
* Be willing to respond to emergent changes rather than focused on existing plans.
* Familiarity with AI concepts and technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing, and data analytics, while ensuring compliance with AI governance frameworks. Leverage these technologies to enhance user experiences and improve decision-making processes within applications.
* Minimum 12 months experience as D1/D2
* Should have at least “On-Track” or equivalent rating in last appraisal.
* Should not be under any Performance Counselling Plan or had any official disciplinary action within the last 3 months.

**What makes you stand out?**

* Ability to craft effective prompts that optimize AI responses, enhancing the functionality of AI-driven applications for problem-solving, analysis, and content generation.
* Capability to work within a POD/ cross-functional squads to develop and implement an AI strategy that aligns with business needs.
* Commitment to staying updated on the latest AI trends, technologies, and best practices to continuously improve AI capabilities within the organization.
* An Agile Mindset with an in-depth understanding of Agile Principles.
* Must have prior experience as an IT Systems Analyst or IT Business Analyst working as part of an agile team using an Agile Workflow tool such as JIRA or TFS.
* Agile Certification, such as CSM, PSM, CSPO, PSPO, PMI-ACP, Certified SAFe Practitioner, Azure AI Fundamentals is desirable.

  .

  **production performance monitoring and incident analysis**

  **capacity planning and forecasting**

  **auto-scaling strategies and infrastructure right-sizing**

  .

drives problems to resolution even across unclear boundaries.Pragmatic: Focused on solutions that work nowCurious: Wants to understand the “why” behind problemsEntrepreneurial: Treats technical problems as business problemsCommunicative: Can translate technical decisions into a business contextAI Native: Exposure to AI systems or prompt & context engineering.Should I apply?YES, if you:Want to work on AI-native products at the frontierEnjoy variety - no two weeks look the sameCare about understanding the “why” behind what you buildPrefer building solutions over strictly following specsI am curious about how engineering decisions affect business outcomesMAYBE NOT, if you:Prefer predictable, tightly defined workDislike exposure to business or customer contextNeed detailed specs to be productivePrefer large teams over small, autonomous podsWant to avoid ambiguity or rapid context-switchingDay-to-day realityNo two weeks look the same, but a typical flow might look like this:Monday: Pod sync to review customer progress and technical blockers. title: Security Validation Lead
description:
**OUR STORY**
**At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today.**
**When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.**
**Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential.**
**Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you.**
**YOUR ROLE**
Attached to the Imaging Validation department, you will join a dynamic and innovative team, an integral part of R&D, working on projects at the state of the art of image sensor technology targeting various markets and applications.
  
  
As a Functional Validation Engineer, you will be involved in validating all the division products. This activity will aim to ensure the adequacy of the functionalities and performances of the product with the specifications by relying on FPGA prototyping first, and on circuit silicon in a second time.
  
  
In this context, you will be responsible for
**Camera Image Sensor SoC validation**
, focusing on
**Security, Secure Streaming, Cryptographic Validation, and System-Level Functional validation**
.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for validating security features across the Camera Image Sensor SoC, ensuring robust implementation of security architectures including
**Secure Boot, Root of Trust, Authentication, Encryption, Hashing, Secure Firmware Update, Secure Streaming, and Anti-Tamper mechanisms**
. The role requires deep understanding of imaging pipelines, embedded systems, security protocols, and automation using Python.
  
  
Throughout the validation, you will also oversee the analysis and resolution of technical challenges. Your product expertise may also be called upon to participate in customer support and integration.
  
  
To succeed in these missions, you will work in close collaboration with all the different product development teams (Design, Architecture, Firmware and embedded software development), with our application teams in order to provide the best validation solution that will meet our customer's needs.
  
  
You will also participate in project meetings, sharing information, actions, and priorities within the team.
  
  
Finally, as a member of a validation team, you will reuse existing tools. You will also propose and participate in methods and tools for improvements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Validate end-to-end security architecture of Camera Image Sensor SoCs.
* Develop comprehensive validation plans for hybrid cryptographic schemes combining classical and PQC algorithms:

+ Secure Boot
+ Chain of Trust
+ Secure Firmware Loading
+ Secure Debug Access
+ Secure Key Provisioning
+ Anti-Tamper Mechanisms
+ Secure Manufacturing Flows
+ Secure video streaming

* Verify authentication and authorization mechanisms.
* Validate OTP -based security configurations.
* Perform negative testing and security robustness testing.

**Your Skills & Experiences**

* Object-oriented programming languages (preferably Python, C)
* Version management tools (git, svn)
* Software, Hardware knowledge and debug capabilities.
* Knowledge:
* Embedded electronics / computing (real time)
* Laboratory tools (oscilloscope, signal generator, etc.)
* Transmission protocols (high and low speed): I2C, I3C, SPI, MIPI, DP, eDP
* Automation and/or continuous integration tools (ex: Jenkins, Gerrit, AI tools)
* Notions in image processing would be an adding competency.

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. title: Assistant Quality Manager
description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced Assistant Quality Manager to oversee process quality and Outgoing Quality Control (OQC) for lithium-ion battery pack assembly and manufacturing for mobile phones. The candidate will be responsible for maintaining product quality, improving manufacturing processes, implementing quality management systems, conducting customer and supplier audits, and ensuring compliance with established quality standards and customer requirements.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Manage process quality and OQC activities for lithium-ion battery pack assembly and manufacturing.
* Monitor manufacturing processes to identify quality issues, prevent defects, and ensure compliance with established specifications and quality standards.
* Develop, review, and implement PFMEA, Control Plans, and other quality documentation.
* Apply quality tools such as FMEA, DOE, PPAP, and 8D to support process improvement and problem-solving.
* Conduct and coordinate customer audits and supplier audits, including Quality Process Audits (QPA).
* Investigate customer complaints, process deviations, and product non-conformities; coordinate root-cause analysis and corrective and preventive actions.
* Maintain and improve the Quality Management System (QMS) and ensure compliance with applicable procedures.
* Coordinate with production, engineering, suppliers, and other relevant teams to resolve quality issues and improve manufacturing performance.
* Prepare quality reports, audit documentation, presentations, and performance updates using MS Office tools.

**Mandatory Requirements**

* B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering.
* 7–10 years of relevant experience in quality assurance and quality control within manufacturing.
* Hands-on knowledge of lithium-ion battery pack assembly/manufacturing for mobile phones is mandatory.
* Practical knowledge of process quality and Outgoing Quality Control (OQC).
* Working knowledge of PFMEA, DOE, PPAP, FMEA, Control Plans, 8D, and QMS.
* Experience in customer audits and supplier audits, particularly QPA.
* Good command of spoken and written English.
* Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
**Job Title: QA ENGINEER & TECHNICAL SUPPORT**

**Location:**
Noida, Sector 63 (On-site)

**Experience:**
2–4 years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a versatile and highly skilled individual to join our team as a QA Engineer and Technical Support professional. This role combines technical expertise in software quality assurance, particularly automation testing, with strong client-facing and project coordination abilities. The successful candidate will help ensure the quality of our software applications while serving as a primary contact for clients, managing their needs, and facilitating effective communication between clients and development teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Software Quality Assurance and Automation**

• Develop and enforce a robust automated software quality engineering strategy, including practices and processes that ensure consistent application quality.

• Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts and frameworks, collaborating closely with project and business teams to improve system effectiveness and efficiency.

• Lead and manage project quality through effective quality engineering practices, ensuring deliverables meet agreed timelines, cost expectations, and quality standards.

• Provide hands-on leadership throughout the QA lifecycle, supporting both manual and automated testing in an Agile environment.

• Estimate testing effort for low- and medium-complexity applications and maintain a comprehensive test coverage matrix.

• Define automation test strategies and test plans for different applications, taking business needs and return on investment (ROI) into account.

• Identify appropriate device coverage for applications.

**Client and Technical Support**

• Serve as the first point of contact for customer concerns related to technical issues, advocate for customers, and communicate their needs to internal developers.

• Respond to and resolve technical inquiries promptly in accordance with established service-level agreement (SLA) guidelines.

• Stay aware of customer business priorities and key events, providing proactive issue-status updates to relevant stakeholders.

• Record and document customer issues according to established processes; troubleshoot and qualify cases before escalating them to developers.

• Troubleshoot implementation problems and investigate complex issues that require in-depth evaluation and problem-solving skills.

• Collaborate with internal teams to learn new concepts, resolve complex issues, and occasionally lead knowledge-sharing sessions.

• Reproduce customer-reported issues using available documentation, knowledge bases, community resources, and peer support.

**Team Leadership and Collaboration**

• Guide and oversee a small team of 3–6 people throughout the software development life cycle (SDLC), from test-case creation through test closure.

• Demonstrate expertise in defect management, including defining and improving defect documentation and the TAR lifecycle process.

• Ensure the team follows established defect-management and other quality processes.

• Mentor and coach team members to support their professional growth.

• Collaborate with development teams to explain client issues and help identify actionable solutions.

**Qualifications**

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology (IT), or a related field.

• Proficiency in both manual testing and hands-on automated testing.

• Experience with Agile/Scrum and Waterfall software development life cycle methodologies.

• 2–4 years of well-rounded quality assurance testing experience.

• At least 1 year of technical support or technical consulting experience.

• Strong organizational skills, with the ability to multitask and prioritize requirements.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

• Preferred: At least 1 year of experience using AI tools.

title: SAP QM (Quality Management)
description:
Job Description: SAP Quality Management (QM)
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and results-driven
**SAP Quality Management (QM) Consultant**
to design, configure, implement, and support robust SAP QM solutions across our manufacturing and supply chain operations. In this role, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional business stakeholders to translate quality and operational requirements into scalable SAP processes.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in end-to-end SAP QM functionalities, seamless integration capabilities with adjacent SAP modules, and hands-on experience in S/4HANA implementations, rollouts, enhancements, and production support.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities

Requirements Gathering & Process Design
  
  

* Engage with business stakeholders to analyze, refine, and document business requirements for Quality Management processes.
* Conduct Fit-Gap analysis between current operational workflows and standard SAP functionalities.
* Author detailed Functional Specifications (FS) for custom developments, reports, interfaces, and enhancements (RICEF objects).

SAP QM Core Configuration & Management
  
  

* Configure and maintain core SAP QM master data and functionalities, including:

+ Inspection Plans, Master Inspection Characteristics (MICs), Sampling Procedures, and Schemes.
+ Catalogs, Selected Sets, and Catalog Profiles.
+ Quality Info Records (QIRs) for Vendor Quality Management.

* Configure and support key QM operational workflows:

+ Quality Planning & Quality Inspection (Incoming, In-Process, and Final Inspections).
+ Results Recording, Defect Recording, and Usage Decisions (UD).
+ Quality Notifications, Root Cause Analysis, and Corrective Action workflows.
+ Quality Certificates creation and processing.

Module Integration & Traceability
  
  

* Ensure seamless cross-module integration between SAP QM and key supply chain/manufacturing modules:

+ Production Planning (PP): In-process inspection lots, routing integrations.
+ Materials Management (MM): Goods receipt inspections, vendor evaluation, stock transfers.
+ Sales & Distribution (SD): Delivery inspections, customer complaints, quality certificates.
+ Plant Maintenance (PM): Calibration inspections and equipment maintenance integration.
+ Extended Warehouse Management (EWM / WM): Warehouse inspection processes, inbound/outbound lot management.

* Oversee and configure Batch Management, including batch determination, classification, and end-to-end material traceability.

Implementation, Testing & Production Support
  
  

* Participate across all project phases: implementation, global rollouts, upgrades, and post-go-live support.
* Execute Unit Testing, Integration Testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Collaborate with ABAP development teams to build and test custom solutions, reports, and system interfaces.
* Provide incident management, ticket resolution, and root cause analysis within defined SLA timelines.
* Support system governance and project documentation using SAP Solution Manager / ALM.

Training & Documentation
  
  

* Develop detailed end-user documentation, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), business process charts, and training manuals.
* Conduct training sessions and knowledge-transfer workshops for business key users and end-users.
* Required Qualifications & Skills

Functional & Domain Expertise
  
  

* SAP QM Expertise: Proven experience in SAP QM module configuration, maintenance, and support across manufacturing or supply chain environments.
* Core Capabilities: In-depth knowledge of Inspection Types, Inspection Lots, Results Recording, Usage Decisions, Quality Notifications, Quality Certificates, Defect Management, and Quality Info Records.
* Master Data Management: Deep proficiency in Inspection Plans, MICs, Sampling Schemes, Catalogs, and Selected Sets.
* Traceability: Strong understanding of Batch Management, batch classification, and full forward/backward supply chain traceability.
* Domain Knowledge: solid understanding of core manufacturing quality management standards and supply chain operations.

Integration Knowledge
  
  

* Hands-on integration experience between SAP QM and:

+ SAP Production Planning (PP)
+ SAP Materials Management (MM)
+ SAP Sales & Distribution (SD)
+ SAP Plant Maintenance (PM)
+ SAP Extended Warehouse Management / Warehouse Management (EWM / WM)

* Exposure to SAP S/4HANA enterprise environments.

Technical & System Exposure
  
  

* Experience writing Functional Specifications (FS) and specifying requirements for RICEF objects.
* Hands-on experience with interface testing and debugging support alongside ABAP teams.
* Proficiency with SAP Solution Manager / Application Lifecycle Management (ALM).

Soft Skills & Competencies
  
  

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to bridge business and technical requirements.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to manage deliverables within strict SLA timelines in production environments.
* Preferred Experience
* Participation in at least one full-lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementation or migration project.
* Experience in regulated manufacturing environments (e.g., Automotive, Life Sciences, Chemical, or Consumer Goods).

title: Senior Principal Consultant
description:
**About Parexel**
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
  
  
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose -- moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart(R).
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Senior Principal Consultant to join our team. As a consultant, you will drive the delivery of comprehensive drug safety solutions that protect patient well-being and ensure regulatory compliance. This position plays a key role in designing and implementing pharmacovigilance strategies, managing complex safety data, and providing expert guidance to clients on emerging safety issues and regulatory requirements. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, apply industry-leading methodologies, and contribute to the successful execution of pharmacovigilance programs from initiation through ongoing monitoring.
  
  
You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through advanced drug safety solutions and strategic client partnerships. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Pharmacovigilance Consulting Services Lead can explore career paths and expand expertise across clinical research, regulatory affairs, and data analytics.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyze business needs and provide strategic guidance to ensure drug safety solutions meet customer objectives and drive successful project outcomes
* Lead solution design and implementation for client engagements, ensuring high-quality, integrated software solutions delivered within project constraints of time and budget
* Serve as a subject matter expert and thought leader, providing technical expertise in drug safety systems including Argus Safety, Insight, Mart, Analytics, OBIEE, and Axway EDI platforms
* Manage and mentor a team of technical consultants and developers, providing coaching, guidance, and feedback to develop team member skills and drive project success
* Present and demonstrate solutions to customers, influencing customer management in acceptance of solutions and ensuring successful business implementation
* Apply hands-on technical expertise in SQL and PL/SQL with strong troubleshooting skills across Argus, Axway, and associated modules to resolve complex technical challenges

**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**

* Strategic thinking and technical leadership capabilities to guide complex drug safety implementations
* Deep experience in drug safety systems, implementation methodologies, and best practices
* Strong SQL and PL/SQL programming skills with excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities
* Proven ability to lead teams, mentor consultants, and collaborate effectively across organizations
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence stakeholder decisions

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's / master’s degree in computer science, information technology, or any engineering degree
* 11+ years of experience relevant to this position, including 5 years of consulting experience in drug safety or clinical research
* Knowledge of ICH-GCP, regulatory requirements, and clinical trial processes
* Experience with pharmacovigilance platforms such as Argus Safety, Insight, Mart, or similar systems
* Extensive knowledge of writing SQL queries and PL/SQL code
* In-depth knowledge of drug safety application implementation, upgrade, and maintenance
* Ability to craft and articulate strategic technology solutions that address complex business challenges

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with E2B(R3) or EDI protocols for adverse event reporting
* Familiarity with additional pharmacovigilance analytics and visualization tools
* Experience in consulting or client-facing roles within the pharmaceutical industry

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.
  
  
If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

title: App Dev Engr/Scient, Inter
description:
**Overview**
Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.
  
  
Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.
  
  
**About The Role**
PowerArtist is a leading RTL power analysis and optimization platform widely adopted across top semiconductor and SoC companies for early power estimation and debug. With increasing industry focus on low-power design and faster tape-outs, PowerArtist plays a critical role in enabling early power closure and design efficiency.
  
  
This position offers strong customer visibility, exposure to advanced SoC programs, and the opportunity to work closely with leading semiconductor customers to drive power optimization/estimation success.
  
  
This role focuses on
**product validation**
, feature qualification, and
**Application Engineering (AE) backend support**
. You will work closely with Product Development, Application Engineering, and key semiconductor customers to validate new capabilities, reproduce and analyze customer-reported issues, develop comprehensive validation strategies, and enable rapid issue resolution. The position offers broad exposure to advanced SoC design flows, strong cross-functional collaboration, and the opportunity to directly influence product quality, customer success, and future feature development.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Validate new PowerArtist features, enhancements, and bug fixes across diverse design environments and customer use cases.
* Develop and maintain feature validation test plans, design suites.
* Perform functional, performance, and quality verification of RTL power analysis flows.
* Reproduce, analyze, and debug customer-reported issues in collaboration with R&D and AE teams.
* Create testcases to verify bug fixes and ensure no regressions are introduced.
* Validate support for new technologies, libraries, simulators, synthesis tools, and waveform formats.
* Analyze RTL power estimation results and verify accuracy against expected behavior.
* Automate validation workflows, regression execution, and result analysis using scripting.
* Provide backend technical support to AE teams by investigating complex customer issues and identifying root causes.
* Collaborate closely with R&D during feature development cycles to improve product quality and usability.
* Support release qualification activities and ensure timely delivery of high-quality product releases.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills:**

* 3+ years of experience in RTL design, verification, power analysis, or EDA tool validation.
* Strong understanding of RTL (Verilog/SystemVerilog) and digital design fundamentals.
* Familiarity with AI/ML and Generative AI technologies, including their application in EDA workflows, validation automation, regression analysis, testcase generation, and productivity enhancement.
* Hands-on experience with PowerArtist or RTL power estimation and analysis methodologies.
* Knowledge of switching activity formats (VCD, FSDB, SAIF) and power modeling concepts.
* Familiarity with dynamic power, clock power, and activity-based power estimation techniques.
* Experience debugging RTL power analysis flows, libraries, constraints, and waveform-related issues.
* Knowledge of synthesis tools (Design Compiler, Genus) and simulation environments (VCS, Xcelium, Questa).
* Strong debugging, root-cause analysis, and log investigation skills.
* Proficiency in TCL, Shell, and/or Python scripting for automation and regression development.
* Ability to work effectively with R&D and AE teams in diagnosing and resolving complex technical issues.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with an emphasis on technical documentation.

title: Senior Manager - IT Business Analysis
description:

Senior Manager - IT Business Analysis - AI
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Systems Analyst is a role in our scaled agile framework POD and Squad model. As part of a POD team the Senior System Analyst will support one or more cross-functional squads comprised of a Squad Lead, Developers, a System Analyst, and Quality Assurance Engineers committed to ensuring the successful design and delivery of complex application solutions centered on the strategic roadmap for one or more key technology capabilities within MMC. The Senior System Analyst will be primarily responsible for directing the cross-functional elicitation and elaboration of requirements across squads in an Agile Team setting.
  
  
As part of your daily activities, you will collaborate with the Product Owner and teams to manage tactical aspects of iteration planning such as the squads’ backlog, backlog grooming, user story refinement, user story estimation, facilitating Sprint Reviews, and participating in Agile Ceremonies. As a trusted part of a team, you will coordinate activities with up to four System Analysts across squads to ensure just-in-time development of the story.
  
  
You will also assist the Product Owner in the development of personas, customer journey maps, story maps and release planning to foster insights and understanding of vision for the team.
  
  
**We will count on you to:**

* Be a highly motivated team player working within MMC Agile culture, within a specified agile framework of Scrum or KANBAN and maintain a willingness for continuously improving your agile mindset.
* Direct analysis on critical initiatives requiring significant strategic change across multiple platforms and products.
* Ensure that teams are consistently converting the business requirements to solutions, consisting of epics and features, considering technical constraints and existing technical architecture/functionality.
* Work with the Product Owner to communicate the product vision, roadmap, value, and MVP to the agile teams to enable empathy and a shared understanding thereby helping the team to formulate an appropriate solution.

* Work in partnership with the Product Owner and agile teams in the creation and maintenance of Product Backlog Items ensuring that Epics and User Stories are continuously prioritized and aligned to the Product Roadmap and MVP.
* Facilitate refinement sessions with the Agile Teams and Business to sufficiently detail out User Stories, to include dependencies.
* Facilitate the Sprint Review ceremony by working with the agile teams, Product Owner, Business and Customer to review, assess and adapt the latest product increment by incorporating customer insights and feedback into the Product Backlog.
* Actively work with Pod Leadership by running assessments processes for the POD and provide constructive feedback towards continuously improving the Systems Analyst function, standards and processes in Global Technology.
* Lead workshops and work collaboratively with data engineers, data architects, technical experts, and AI engineers to integrate AI solutions into a POD.
* Demonstrate an awareness of MMC and Mercer Technical, Security and Process Standards and work with the team to incorporate them in product delivery through the software development life cycle.

**What you need to have:**

* Highly motivated candidate who is an inquisitive rapid learner that is comfortable working as part of a remote team.
* Possess strong communication skills with the capability of working collaboratively within the organization, regardless of boundaries.
* An effective communicator for both technical and business-oriented audience.
* Demonstrated requirements gathering skills showcasing the capture of customer needs and business drivers using a variety of techniques into product backlog items such as Epics and User Stories.
* Proven quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Skilled in providing process improvement and integration opportunities with other process automation tools.
* Self-motivated and ability to learn through research and self-training.
* Ability to remove impediments for squads by providing timely responses and solutions as required.
* Ability to find resolutions regarding own work methods requiring minimal direction.
* Be willing to respond to emergent changes rather than focused on existing plans.
* Familiarity with AI concepts and technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing, and data analytics, while ensuring compliance with AI governance frameworks. Leverage these technologies to enhance user experiences and improve decision-making processes within applications.

**What makes you stand out?**

* Ability to craft effective prompts that optimize AI responses, enhancing the functionality of AI-driven applications for problem-solving, analysis, and content generation.
* Capability to work within a POD/ cross-functional squads to develop and implement an AI strategy that aligns with business needs.
* Commitment to staying updated on the latest AI trends, technologies, and best practices to continuously improve AI capabilities within the organization.
* An Agile Mindset with an in-depth understanding of Agile Principles.
* Must have prior experience as an IT Systems Analyst or IT Business Analyst working as part of an agile team using an Agile Workflow tool such as JIRA or TFS.
* Agile Certification, such as CSM, PSM, CSPO, PSPO, PMI-ACP, Certified SAFe Practitioner, Azure AI Fundamentals is desirable.

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.

title: Senior Suppliers Development Engineer
description:

The mission is to sustainably elevate performance, quality, and nuclear safety standards of industrial partners to secure critical projects in a demanding environment.
  
  
This role focuses on the structural development of suppliers, addressing the core elements that determine supplier reliability:
  
  

* Excellence of the Quality Management System
* Strengthening of nuclear safety culture and requirements
* Organizational and documentation robustness, including sub-tier supplier
* management
* Continuous improvement capability and risk control

The role is suited for a structured and rigorous engineer with strong quality expertise, mastering the industrial production process from order intake to delivery. With excellent interpersonal skills, the individual acts as a true change driver, supporting suppliers through a Lean approach.
  
  
Working closely with internal experts, the Supplier Development Engineer assesses supplier maturity by conducting audits, analyzing organization, and identifying risks and weak signals. Supported by sourcing strategy, he/she develops and leads high-impact development plans (including operational aspects), supports suppliers in transforming their practices, and ensures the effectiveness of implemented actions.
  
  
**The Suppliers Covered Include**

* New Arabelle Solutions suppliers
* Current suppliers with quality performance issues
* Strategic suppliers for the company

This role directly contributes to supplier panel maturity, nuclear supply chain reliability, and the success of Arabelle Solutions projects.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities**

* Contribute to and validate the global supplier selection strategy with sourcing teams
* Prepare, plan, and conduct assessment audits (ISO 9001, ISO 19443, customer requirements, internal standards) at supplier sites
* Evaluate and challenge suppliers’ organizational structure and processes to meet nuclear technical and administrative requirements; assess safety culture (organization, supply chain monitoring, competency management, process robustness, documentation control)
* Identify and mitigate gaps, weak signals, and risks affecting quality or safety
* Deliver structured and actionable reports
* Coordinate with internal technical experts for supplier-related actions
* Develop pragmatic and measurable supplier development plans (actions, deadlines, KPIs)
* Drive supplier maturity improvement through Lean coaching, follow-up, and effectiveness assessment
* Promote best practices while respecting confidentiality rules
* Develop and improve supplier qualification, maturity standards, and development programs, leveraging synergies within the EDF Group

**Required Skills**
**Technical Skills**

* Training or certification in nuclear safety / ISO 19443 is a plus
* Minimum 10 years of experience in quality, audits, or supplier development, ideally in regulated industries (nuclear, energy, rail, aerospace)
* Knowledge of manufacturing processes
* Strong command of Quality Management Systems (ISO 9001 required)
* Good understanding of nuclear safety culture
* Expertise in operational excellence in manufacturing
* Experience in QMS, organizational and process audits
* Strong knowledge of industrial production processes

**Behavioral Skills**

* Strong leadership and change management capability
* Excellent communication, listening, analytical and synthesis skills
* Rigor, autonomy, and initiative
* Strong interpersonal skills with diverse stakeholders
* Proactive mindset

**Profile And Requirements**

* Engineering degree or equivalent
* Fluent in English (written and spoken); French is a plus

**WORKING CONDITIONS**

* Willingness to travel to supplier sites

**The Role: Lead Quality Engineer**
**The Team**
Enterprise Solutions (ES) Technology brings together data, software, services, and expertise to deliver innovative solutions for global financial markets. The team works closely with customers to help them manage complex business, regulatory, and risk requirements.
  
  
Financial Risk Analytics (FRA), part of Enterprise Solutions, delivers information-centric capital markets and risk solutions for trading desks and their risk-management partners. Its products support counterparty credit risk, xVA, and market risk for both buy-side and sell-side institutions.
  
  
We are seeking a Lead Quality Engineer to join the FRA Technology team. Quality Engineering is embedded throughout the software development lifecycle and spans application, analytics, data, integration, and platform layers. The successful candidate will help evolve QA from a primarily validation-focused function into a proactive, automation-first, engineering-led capability.
  
  
**The Impact**
As a Lead Quality Engineer, you will own and influence the quality strategy across the software delivery lifecycle—from requirements and solution design through development, release, and production support. You will partner with Product, Engineering, DevOps, Architecture, Operations, and Customer Support teams to identify risks early, improve test coverage, increase release confidence, and promote shared accountability for quality.
  
  
This role requires strong technical expertise, a solid understanding of financial risk platforms, and the ability to lead quality initiatives across agile delivery teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own and continuously improve the quality strategy across the full software development lifecycle, embedding effective quality gates from requirements and design through release and production support.

* Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, software testing principles, test design techniques, and quality engineering practices.
* Experience with SQL and relational databases; knowledge of PL/SQL, NoSQL databases, and Linux/UNIX environments is desirable.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and working with build and deployment processes.
* Understanding of performance, integration, regression, data, security, and non-functional testing practices.
* Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex issues across application, data, and platform layers.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present quality risks and recommendations to technical and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively across cross-functional and geographically distributed agile teams.
* Ability to operate independently, take ownership, influence engineering decisions, and drive quality improvements across the organisation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

description:
Experience: 1–2 years

Reports to: QA Lead / Engineering Manager

Employment Type: Full-time

About Company:

Ruloans is one of India's leading loan distribution platforms. It connects borrowers with 200+ banks and NBFCs. Through Ruconnect, our B2B partner platform, thousands of Direct Selling Agents (DSAs) submit leads, track applications and manage their commissions. Our tech team builds the borrower journeys, partner tools, CRM, bank recommendation engine and automation that run this ecosystem.

Role Summary:

We're hiring a QA Engineer (Level 1) to help us ship reliable releases across the Ruloans web platform, the Ruconnect partner app, our internal CRM and backend APIs. You'll handle structured manual testing and grow into test automation: writing and maintaining UI and API test scripts and plugging them into our release pipeline.

Key Responsibilities

Testing & Quality

1. Create, execute, and maintain test cases and test scenarios based on product requirements (BRDs, PRDs, user stories).
2. Run functional, regression, smoke and sanity testing on web, mobile and API releases.
3. Test key lending journeys, such as lead creation, eligibility and CIBIL checks, document upload, application status tracking and DSA commission flows.
4. Log, track and retest defects with clear steps to reproduce, severity, screenshots and logs.
5. Take part in sprint ceremonies and give QA sign-off before production releases.

QA Documentation & Test Management

1. Maintain QA documentation, including test plans, test reports, bug reports, and regression suites.
2. Organize test cases using tags for module, priority, test type, platform, and execution status.

Ensure requirement traceability, test coverage, and documentation updates for every release.

Automation

1. Write and maintain automated UI test scripts using Selenium, Playwright or Cypress.
2. Automate REST API tests using Postman/Newman or RestAssured/PyTest.
3. Add automated test suites to CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins/GitHub Actions) under the guidance of senior engineers.
4. Keep test data, test suites and automation reports up to date.

Data & Backend Checks

1. Write basic SQL queries (MySQL) to check that data was saved correctly after a transaction.
2. Use logging and monitoring tools (e.g., Kibana) to dig into failures and API errors.

Required Skills

1. At least 1 year of hands-on experience in software testing, including some exposure to test automation.
2. Solid grasp of SDLC, STLC, defect lifecycle and test design techniques (boundary value analysis, equivalence partitioning).
3. Hands-on with at least one automation tool: Selenium, Playwright or Cypress.
4. Working knowledge of one programming language: Java, Python or JavaScript.
5. Experience testing REST APIs with Postman (status codes, request/response validation, auth headers). Basic SQL: SELECT, JOIN, WHERE, GROUP BY.
6. Familiar with a bug-tracking or project tool such as ClickUp, Jira or similar.
7. Strong attention to detail and clear written communication.

Good to Have

1. Exposure to mobile app testing (Android/iOS) or Appium.
2. Basic knowledge of Git and CI/CD pipelines.
3. Experience with BFSI/fintech/lending products (KYC, loan applications, credit checks).
4. Awareness of basic security and performance testing (e.g., JMeter).
5. ISTQB Foundation certification.

title: AI Safety Research & Testing Professional
description:
**Role Summary**

The AI Safety Research & Testing Professional will play a key technical role in advancing AI safety research and evaluation capabilities. The role involves designing and conducting structured, code-based evaluations of publicly accessible AI models and AI-enabled products, and developing Python-based evaluation pipelines to support these activities.

The Professional will conduct hands-on technical testing, adversarial evaluation, failure analysis, and comparative benchmarking, while monitoring emerging AI safety and security research. The role will translate empirical findings, published frameworks, and established standards into practical guidance, readiness assessments, and recommendations for industry members and partners.

This is a hands-on, technically focused research and testing role covering model APIs, open-source evaluation frameworks, evaluation datasets, automated testing, RAG, tool use, agents, and other AI-enabled application components.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Research & Landscape Analysis**

* Conduct structured literature reviews of AI safety and security research, including reports from AI safety institutes, evaluation labs, and research organisations.
* Track frontier and open-weight model releases and assess their safety and security implications.
* Monitor emerging research on evaluation, red-teaming, robustness, interpretability, alignment, AI security, RAG, and agentic systems.
* Assess relevant evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, attack methodologies, and testing tools.
* Contribute to the Global & Regional AI Safety Landscape briefing and internal knowledge base.

**Technical Testing & Evaluation**

* Design and implement evaluation pipelines using open-source frameworks and custom Python tooling to test publicly accessible models and AI-enabled products.
* Build and maintain test scripts, model/API integrations, structured test cases, scoring rubrics, automated grading, and reporting pipelines.
* Test key risk areas including prompt injection, indirect injection, jailbreaks, data leakage/PII exposure, hallucination, adversarial robustness, bias/fairness, over- and under-refusal, and agent/tool-use safety.
* Evaluate application-level risks across RAG, system prompts, tool/function calling, external APIs, memory/state, and agentic workflows.
* Conduct structured adversarial testing and red-teaming, including multi-turn and adaptive attacks where appropriate.
* Develop reusable attack libraries, evaluation datasets, edge cases, and regression test suites.
* Run comparative benchmarking across open-weight and commercial models and products, combining quantitative scorecards with qualitative failure analysis.

**Evaluation Methodology & Failure Analysis**

* Design rigorous and reproducible evaluations covering objectives, test-set construction, sampling, baselines, scoring criteria, assumptions, and limitations.
* Apply appropriate quantitative and statistical methods, including repeated trials, uncertainty analysis, and error analysis.
* Assess the reliability and limitations of automated evaluation, including LLM-as-judge approaches and human-evaluation agreement where relevant.
* Investigate, reproduce, classify, and document failures and identify likely model-, prompt-, data-, retrieval-, tool-, or application-level causes.
* Assess severity and prioritise findings based on likelihood, exploitability, impact, and potential downstream consequences.

**Automation, Regression & Mitigation Testing**

* Develop automated safety regression testing to detect behavioural changes across model versions, prompts, fine-tuning, RAG configurations, tools, and application releases.
* Maintain evaluation pipelines and results repositories for longitudinal tracking and benchmarking.
* Evaluate proposed safeguards through pre- and post-mitigation testing and verify that fixes do not introduce new failure modes.
* Apply appropriate version control, logging, configuration management, and reproducibility practices.

**Advisory, Training & Knowledge Sharing**

* Support AI safety/security readiness assessments, gap analyses, model risk registers, and incident-response playbooks.
* Translate testing results into practical recommendations for AI risk identification, evaluation, monitoring, and management.
* Contribute technical content to workshops and hands-on AI safety testing modules.
* Present methodologies and findings at relevant conferences, working groups, and technical dialogues.

**Required Qualifications**

* 2-3 years of relevant experience in AI/ML engineering, applied ML research, AI safety, AI red-teaming, security research, data science, or a related technical field.
* Solid Python proficiency, including REST APIs, JSON, pandas/requests, and development of maintainable evaluation scripts and pipelines.
* Hands-on experience with an LLM evaluation/red-teaming framework or demonstrable experience building custom evaluation tooling.
* Working understanding of modern LLM development and deployment, including pretraining, fine-tuning/RLHF, RAG, system prompting, tool use, and agentic architectures.
* Working knowledge of major AI safety/security failure categories and ability to reason about attack surfaces and abuse cases.
* Comfortable reading and synthesising technical research papers and evaluation reports.
* Familiarity with Git, version control, testing, debugging, and reproducible development practices.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field; Master’s/research experience is a strong plus.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**

* Experience with AI red-teaming, CTFs, security research challenges, or adversarial evaluation.
* Experience developing AI safety benchmarks, evaluation datasets, attack libraries, or reusable evaluation harnesses.
* Experience with automated red-teaming, jailbreak research, prompt-injection testing, or adaptive attacks.
* Experience with LLM-as-judge evaluation, human evaluation, or evaluation reliability analysis.
* Experience with agent frameworks or RAG pipelines such as LangChain, AutoGen, or similar.
* Familiarity with AI/ML security risks such as model extraction, membership inference, memorisation, data poisoning, or RAG/agent security.
* Experience with Docker, cloud environments, CI/CD, experiment tracking, or evaluation infrastructure.
* Public/open-source contributions related to AI safety, ML, security, evaluation tooling, or research.
* Participation in an AI safety fellowship, programme, research group, or professional community.

title: Service Engineer - PSA
description:
**Job Description Summary**
Come Join Our Software Integration Team!! Our main activity consists in setting up GE Vernova software in different environments for internal and external customers, supporting project activities and providing expertise in tailoring the components based on requirements. We have a hybrid work environment as we work from home, the office and travel to customer sites as needed. The integration engineer is a key member in all projects, being engaged throughout the full lifecycle (Development, Factory Acceptance Tests, Site Acceptance Tests, Cutover, Support).
  
  
**Job Description**
GE Vernova allows us to bring a significant contribution to the Worldwide Electrical Energy context. Delivering on life-critical solutions we are deeply immersed into the worlds of Transmission, Distribution, Asset Management and Market Management making sure we shape how the energy landscape looks today and tomorrow.
  
  
Our teams breathe software-life into R&D, Services and Support for GE Vernova Electrification Software’s products while liaising with stakeholders and customers all around the globe.
  
  
GE Vernova is a global provider of software, hardware, services, and expertise in automation and embedded computing. We offer a unique foundation of agile and reliable technology providing customers a sustainable competitive advantage in the industries they serve, including energy, water, consumer packaged goods, oil & gas, government & defense, and telecommunications.
  
  
The activity within this office consists of development and implementation of:
  
  

* Energy Management Systems (EMS)
* Distribution Management Systems (DMS)

Different specialized teams for distinct technical fields contribute to the realization of these systems. (hardware, communications, databases, HMI, applications).
  
  
One of the activities, carried out in the mentioned context, is engineering for specific monitoring and control of power systems applications (power flow, short-circuit calculation state estimator, contingency analysis, optimization in power systems, voltage control, load frequency control, power reserve management, load forecast, stability analysis, transient regimes, modeling of the equipment, of the automation and protection systems in power plants and of the power grids, energy market models).
  
  
**Main Job Responsibilities**

* Development of the mathematical models of the physical phenomena in the power systems
* Software development for real-time applications (code, testing)
* Carrying out the analysis to define the specifications for the real time monitoring and control systems
* Commissioning of the EMS, DMS systems
* Engineering and code development for the EMS, DMS systems that meets the high standards.
* Parameterization, optimization, testing of EMS, DMS systems
* Databases management
* Good technical background is required. The development of professional skills is achieved, in time, by involvement in the team activities and by trainings.
* Knowledge of the power systems phenomena and processes and related mathematical models (power flow, state estimator, short-circuit analysis, contingency analyst, voltage control, load-frequency control, power systems optimal regimes, load forecast, stability analysis, transient analysis, modeling of equipment and of automation and protection systems in power plants and power grids, DTS, models for the energy market)
* C / C ++ programmer skills or similar
* Exposure in Modelling of SCADA and Power System Analyst Applications
* Familiarity or development experience on Windows OS or UNIX OS

**Qualifications / Requirements**

* Master's degree in Power Systems with 2 to 5 years of experience in the PSA Domain
* Troubleshooting skills
* Fluent in English
* Ability and willingness to travel

Desired Characteristics
  
  

* Technically good performer who can integrate and test complex software systems to completion with a minimal supervision
* Excellent communication skills (verbal and written)
* Rigorous, methodical, well organized and self-disciplined
* Take initiatives, good trouble-shooter and autonomous
* Adaptability, reactivity and Availability
* Ability to analyze complex topics and make a verbal/written synthesis
* Ability and willingness to travel

Network & Links
  
  

* Internal: Operations, Product Development, Tendering, and Maintenance & Support
* External: Customers, Partners

Performance Measurement
  
  

* On Time Delivery
* Costs deviation + Committed budget (effort) deviation
* Software Delivery Processes Compliance

In collaboration with Methods & Tools
